text:
nina_csm: Heads-up RiverBank onboarding: token spend up 19% and p95 for /answer is drifting toward 850ms during daytime peaks. They're on hosted trial and worried about renewal. Proactive idea: small canary of compact-13b-int8 for non-sensitive routes + schedule routing to cheaper variant during peak window.
leo_ml: Share the tail numbers?
nina_csm: p50 140ms -> 260ms, p95 850ms, p99 1400ms. Peak window 14:30-15:15 UTC. A good chunk of requests include long policy text (~3.5k tokens).
aria_se: Budget? Any committed spend?
nina_csm: Hosted, trial. Renewal interest but fragile if costs rise.
leo_ml: Plan: 1) Canary compact-13b-int8 at 5% for 24h. 2) Enable prefix KV caching for repeated policy blocks. 3) Route peak window to compact model or reserved pool if customer signs a short commit.
aria_se: I'll draft the enablement checklist and rollback thresholds. Suggest similarity gate: embeddings cosine >= 0.975 and latency SLO p95 < 900ms.
nina_csm: Can you give a tiny routing snippet they can paste?
leo_ml: Minimal example: ```{ "route":"riverbank-prod/answer", "schedule":[{"when":"14:30-15:15","preferred":"compact-13b-int8","fallback":"open-13b-fp16"}], "canary":{"model":"compact-13b-int8","pct":5} }```
aria_se: Ops note: binding reserved pools requires billing approval. ops-bot: reserved-pool changes will open a billing PR.
nina_csm: Great. I'll send a one-pager + offer a 30m enablement call tomorrow. leo_ml: I'll run a 5k sim and post quick numbers in ~3h.
